text:
maria: quick callout from mobile QA: when the console switches to compact list at ~390px the row actions float over text and the sticky header overlaps status pills. screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/mobile-reflow-390.png
leo: noted. seems like two issues: header z-index + row wrapping. on narrow widths the pills wrap under the first column and mess with alignment.
chris: repro: collapse left nav, reduce width to 390, open list, scroll rapidly. header should remain sticky but not overlap the first row's content.
anya: proposal: at <=400px switch to stacked card rows (title + meta lines) instead of multi-column table. keeps actions below content and avoids overlap. also reduces horizontal scrolling.
sam: implementation idea: use a CSS layout-change at 400px: table -> card. use transform translateY for sticky header with pointer-events:none to avoid intercepting taps. snippet: ```@media(max-width:400px){ .table{display:block} .row{display:block;padding:12px} .sticky{transform:translateY(var(--sticky-offset));pointer-events:none} }```
maria: also noticed overflow menu label wraps to two lines. copy tweak: change "View details" -> "Details" on small screens. shorter and screen-reader friendly.
leo: a11y: when switching to card mode, ensure each card has role=listitem and the container role=list. announce changes when layout toggles? maybe avoid surprise by not auto-animating.
chris: touch targets: action icons should be minimum 44px when stacked. make primary action first in DOM for easier reach when using one thumb.
anya: UX nit: add a subtle divider between cards and increase hit area for expand chevron to 48px. users on foldables saw accidental taps otherwise.
sam: performance: avoid remounting large DOM on breakpoint change. prefer CSS-only layout toggle where possible, lazy-load expanded content only.
design-bot: preview build: https://staging.redwood/preview/card-mode-1795 90% compact rows + header fix.
maria: quick test plan: 3-person thumb reach test on iPhone SE, Pixel 4a, and Galaxy Fold. check keyboard nav and screen reader focus order when cards expand.
leo: action items: sam will prototype card layout + header fix, anya will write copy bit, chris will run a11y checklist. aim to merge in the next hotfix. :rocket:
